parsed.name: BLE到LSL数据流组件
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件组件，用于连接蓝牙低功耗（BLE）设备，订阅其通知数据，将收到的样本整理为数据块并发布到 Lab Streaming Layer（LSL）输出流中，供实验中的实时采集、同步和显示使用。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software component that connects to a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) device, subscribes to its notifications, organizes incoming samples into chunks, and publishes them to a Lab Streaming Layer (LSL) outlet for real-time acquisition, synchronization, and visualization in experiments.
